---
title: "Normal Distribution PDF and CDF Visualization"
author: "Anthony Morciglio"
date: "10/01/2025"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Parameters
mu <- 0       # mean
sigma <- 1    # standard deviation
x <- seq(mu - 4*sigma, mu + 4*sigma, length.out = 1000)

# PDF and CDF values
pdf_vals <- dnorm(x, mean = mu, sd = sigma)
cdf_vals <- pnorm(x, mean = mu, sd = sigma)

df <- data.frame(x = x, pdf = pdf_vals, cdf = cdf_vals)

# Breakpoints for shading regions
bounds <- c(-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3) * sigma + mu

pdf_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x, pdf)) +
  geom_line(color="blue", size=1) +
  # ±1σ
  geom_area(data = subset(df, x >= mu - sigma & x <= mu + sigma),
            aes(y=pdf), fill="blue", alpha=0.4) +
  # ±2σ
  geom_area(data = subset(df, x >= mu - 2*sigma & x <= mu + 2*sigma),
            aes(y=pdf), fill="blue", alpha=0.25) +
  # ±3σ
  geom_area(data = subset(df, x >= mu - 3*sigma & x <= mu + 3*sigma),
            aes(y=pdf), fill="blue", alpha=0.15) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mu, linetype="dashed", color="black", size=1) +
  labs(title = "Normal Distribution PDF",
       subtitle = "Shaded ±1, ±2, ±3 Standard Deviations",
       x = "Y", y = "Density") +
  annotate("text", x = mu, y = max(df$pdf)*0.8,
           label = "Mean = Median = Mode", vjust = -1, color="black") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14)

pdf_plot

cdf_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x, cdf)) +
  geom_line(color="darkgreen", size=1) +
  # ±1σ
  geom_area(data = subset(df, x >= mu - sigma & x <= mu + sigma),
            aes(y=cdf), fill="darkgreen", alpha=0.4) +
  # ±2σ
  geom_area(data = subset(df, x >= mu - 2*sigma & x <= mu + 2*sigma),
            aes(y=cdf), fill="darkgreen", alpha=0.25) +
  # ±3σ
  geom_area(data = subset(df, x >= mu - 3*sigma & x <= mu + 3*sigma),
            aes(y=cdf), fill="darkgreen", alpha=0.15) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mu, linetype="dashed", color="black", size=1) +
  labs(title = "Normal Distribution CDF",
       subtitle = "Shaded ±1, ±2, ±3 Standard Deviations",
       x = "Y", y = "Cumulative Probability") +
  annotate("text", x = mu, y = 0.5,
           label = "Mean = Median = Mode", vjust = -1, color="black") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14)

cdf_plot
